bio.text: Anthony Merante is the Republican candidate for New York State Senate District 35 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Andrea Stewart-Cousins.

A June 2026 campaign press release describes him as a certified public accountant and local businessman who was elected to the Yonkers City Council in 2017 and served two terms representing the 6th District.
The release also says he was president of the Sprain Lake Knolls Civic Association before joining the council.
